lane: تعارّ 6 He awoke from his sleep, (S, A, O,) in the night, with a sound, or cry, (S, O,) or speaking, or talking: (A:) he was sleepless, and turned over upon the bed, by night, speaking, or talking, (A, K,) and with a sound, or cry, and, as some say, stretching. (TA.) A'Obeyd says that some derive it [as Z does] from عِرَارٌ, signifying the “ crying ” of a male ostrich; but that he knows not whether it be so or not. (TA.)

entries.text: تعار، ككتاب: جبل ببلاد قيس، ورجال. وتعر، كمنع: صاح. وجرح تعار، ككتان: لا يرقأ. والتعر، محركة: اشتعال الحرب.
